messages:
maya: Quick triage — we need to align rate-limit / quota design with pricing for chat/completions + embeddings + rerank + function-calls. Proposal: per-route limits + token accounting by model_variant. Launch criteria: documented billing labels (price_per_1k_tokens), migration path for existing APIs, and graceful fallback when quotas are hit. Any major objections?

sam: +1 to per-route. Quick question: enforcement granularity? per-minute sliding window vs per-user-per-route vs org-level? This changes how we surface billing. I'm leaning per-minute window with soft-burst credits.

elena: From customers — enterprise deals want reserved per-route capacity + burst credits. Also ask for explicit model pricing in the model catalog (e.g. price_per_1k_tokens). Add a `billing_class` tag so sales can map SKUs.

raj: Draft route config to discuss (example):
```json
{
  "route": "/api/v1/chat",
  "rate_limit": {"window_sec": 60, "max_requests": 120},
  "token_accounting": {"granularity": "token", "model_prices": {"redwood-embed-v1": "0.002/1k", "open-quant-v2": "0.0012/1k"}},
  "quota": {"monthly_tokens": 1000000, "burst_credits": 5000},
  "billing_label": "chat.standard"
}
```
Implementation note: enforcement should be edge-friendly — add `X-Rate-Limit-Policy` header so ingress can short-circuit. Billing pipeline events must include `model_variant` + `tokens_consumed` per request.

maya: Good sample. For scope negotiation: keep initial launch to two surfaces — chat/completions and embeddings. Rerank and tool-calls can be treated as variant flags (same accounting but different price). Launch checklist: API fields doc, SDK default semantics, billing mapping, migration guide, and stress test for burst scenarios.

sam: @maya I'll prototype edge enforcement + emulator for per-minute sliding window and run cost sims. Expect to post numbers by Wed. :thumbsup:

elena: I'll coordinate with sales + customer success on migration language. We need two feature flags: `per_route_quota` and `org_fallback_quota` so we can roll customers gradually.

ops-bot: Reminder — weekly roadmap sync Fri 10:00am. I've added "Rate limits & pricing alignment" to the agenda. :spiral_calendar:

maya: Thanks — adding acceptance criteria to the doc: 1) All requests emitted to billing pipeline with model_variant + token counts; 2) SDKs expose pricing fields; 3) Default enforcement behaviour documented; 4) Canary rollout plan + metrics (token underrun, 429 rate, billing deltas).

sam: Sounds good. I'll attach perf numbers once the emulator is up.

elena: Putting migration note in the customer-facing doc draft now.

raj: One more infra ask — we need to version the rate policy config so we can roll back quickly. I'll propose config schema v1.0 by EOD.

maya: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll finalize scope in Thurs sync.
